name: Helpdesk / ITSM
desc: Build a service desk — omnichannel ticketing, ITIL workflows, and AI-resolution agents.
features:
## Core
- Omnichannel ticketing inbox — email, chat, web form, social, SMS in one workspace
- Ticket routing & assignment — skills / capacity / priority-based, round-robin
- SLA policies — targets, business hours, breach escalation
- Knowledge base & self-service portal — articles, versioning, deflection
- No-code automation engine — triggers, macros, canned responses
- Reporting & dashboards — CSAT, ticket volume, resolution time
- Role-based agent permissions & audit logs
- REST API + app marketplace

## ITSM depth
- Incident management — logging, categorization, major-incident workflow
- Problem management — root-cause analysis, known-error & workaround tracking
- Change management — risk assessment, CAB approvals, change calendar
- Service catalog & request fulfillment
- Asset & configuration management (CMDB) with auto-discovery
- On-call scheduling & alerting

## Differentiators
- Autonomous AI resolution agents — full-resolution bots across every channel
- Agent-assist copilot — AI-drafted replies, summaries, next-best-action
- AI-generated KB articles from resolved tickets + generative search
- Workforce management & AI quality scoring
